title: Improving Large Language Model (LLM) fidelity through context-aware grounding: A systematic approach to reliability and veracity
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the detection and mitigation of social biases related to the sensitive attribute of religion in text.
findings: The paper evaluated its context-grounded framework on the SBIC dataset, where 20% of the annotated biases were related to religion. While specific performance metrics for the religion attribute were not detailed separately, the overall findings showed that the proposed context-aware model (T5-small) achieved higher bias detection accuracy and better fairness scores (Disparate Impact Score and Equal Opportunity Difference) across all sensitive attributes, including religion, compared to non-contextual and simpler context-aware baseline models.
